name: [🌧️] Harpoon a Fish
desc:
⭐ Use Code: MONSTER to get +3k XP and +3 Ruby Keys ⭐

🔱 Welcome to Harpoon a Fish🔱

🍔Get FAT and SINK deeper to discover and catch new sea monsters! Fill out your index with over 1,800+ UNIQUE fish! 
🥇STEAL from others! Harpoon other player's fish and test your skill! Only one can catch the trophy. 
⏫EVOLVE your fish and grow the BIGGEST and RAREST sea monster you can find! Be careful though, danger lurks the deeper you go...

[How To Harpoon]
• Aim at your target and FIRE!
• Time your reels to pull in the fish!
• Test your skill and STEAL from others!
• Put caught fish in your aquarium and GROW YOUR NEW PET!
